name: Flow-Field Particles
description: Generative-art particle system driven by a 2D curl-noise flow field. 5 palettes, real-time controls, interactive pointer disturbance.
spec: Build a generative particle flow-field in a single HTML page. Each particle's velocity is sampled from a 2D noise field (curl-noise look). Trails fade slowly so particles paint a flow image. Provide live controls for particle count, speed, noise scale, fade rate, and a palette picker (5 palettes: Aurora, Sunset, Magma, Ocean, Mono). Pointer drag should disturb particles. No external libraries.
